notes.title: ToledoVR - Update 2.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

In this update we have fixed some bugs:

[list]
    [*]Use the grab button to switch weapons/special abilities
    [*]Fixed blocked special abilities PC Player

[/list]

Furthermore we have released a updated version of the demo.

Right now we are working on oculus support and a new map.

notes.title: ToledoVR - Update 2.0
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's been a while since the last update. We've been working hard to make ToledoVR a true RTS game for VR. Thanks for all the support so far.

Patch notes
------------
New game modes:
[list]
[*]Real time strategy (RTS): Create buildings and train units.VR and/or PC (1 vs 1)
[*]Survival: Defend against incoming enemies and attack their bases. Create buildings and train units. VR and/or PC (co-op).
[/list]
Map:
[list]
[*]New desert map added
[*]New survival map added
[/list]
Units:
[list]
[*]Minotaur, Golem, Troll, Centaur and more added
[/list]
Buildings:
[list]
[*]Baracks, House,Statue, Market added
[*]Nexus is defending against enemies (map2 only)
[/list]
Skills:
[list]
[*]All skills are now cooldown based, level up to unlock new skills
[*]New PC skills:
[list]
[*]Crossbow added for third person pc player added (map2 only)
[*]Crossbow Skills added(Map2 only):   
[list]
[*] Strong shot
[*] Explosive shot
[*] Spin attack
[*] Melee attack
[/list]
[*]Shield charge (map2 only) 
[*]Melee attack (map2 only)
[*]Ice meteor (map2 only)
[*]Fire meteor (map2 only)
[*]Meteor shower (map2 only)
[*]Root attack (map2 only)
[*]New ultimate skill (map2 only)
[/list]
[*]New VR skills:
[list]
[*]Fireball
[*]Shield
[*]Heal
[*]Ultimate
[/list]
[/list]
AI:
[list]
[*]Map2 AI bots added
[*]Enemy survival bases added
[/list]
New settings:
[list]
[*]Max units
[*]Physics quality
[/list]
Miscellaneous:
[list]
[*]VR start menu added
[*]AI improvements
[*]Enhanced performance
[*]Quality settings affect terrain performance & more
[*]Postprocessing updated
[*]Lighting changes
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
We are excited to present our first big update!

New Features:

[list]
   [*]New level system for both the VR and PC Player
   [*]Mini-Map for the VR Player - use the grab button
   [*]New Weapon Models
   [*]New Dash-Image
[/list]

New Abilities/Weapons VR Player:

[list]
   [*]Sword
   [*]Force Pulse
   [*]Lightningstorm
   [*]Meteor Shower
   [*]Spawn orcs
[/list]

New Abilities/Weapons PC Player:

[list]
   [*]Spin Attack
   [*]Charge Attack
   [*]Bomb
   [*]Spawn orcs
[/list]

Bug fixes:

[list]
   [*]PC Player movement / attacks
   [*]VR Player movement
   [*]Sound fixes
   [*] & many more
[/list]

Other:

[list]
   [*]Balance changes
   [*]Added more towers
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
Improvements / new features
[list]
[*]New enemy
[*]Harder difficulty for singleplayer
[*]Gold can now only be earned when landing the killing blow
[*]Healthbars
[*]New spawn platforms
[*]Arrows can no longer kill towers from afar
[*]Small balance fixes
[/list]
 
Bug fixes
[list]
[*]Various movement related fixes
[/list]

Comming soon
[list]
[*]Improved AI
[*]New dash effect
[*]More bugfixes / improvements
[/list]

We are also currently working on a new map with more strategy elements and a mastery system for unlocking new weapon/abilities during the game.

[*]Arrows can no longer kill towers from afar
